detail: The resolved session ID is 'a session of this harness process' (subagent and /clear pins share the process), not necessarily the caller's own; SP-016 and SP-017 must not key per-session data on it without telling them apart (documented in docs/internals/daemon.md, Caller sessions). The start time of orchd's child on a task's path is read just after the walk, like the harness's (RC-13).
